decisions.reason: Attributes the sole crash to plugin A's unconditional useSessionPendingInteraction call, explains alpha.2 replaced it with useSessionStatus while useSessions stays, and clears plugin B of standard-kit hook usage.

Cites dock-render-tree and console: one shared input.dock DrawerErrorBoundary whose null fallback unmounts the whole slot; attach button survives in the separately-bounded conversation.input.left slot.

Correctly limits the disable test to proving A caused the unmount; states it neither proves B's general alpha.2 compatibility nor that A's crash is the only dock defect; explains reinstalling B is useless and refutes the both-plugins theory since B uses no kit hooks.

Corrected code reads pending via useSessionStatus(...).pendingInteraction with feature detection and stable empty-map fallbacks, never calling a missing hook; explains silent degradation is required because a throw unmounts co-tenants; non-pending features keep working.

Verification without host restart via client bundle reload, both entries mounted together, and B regression covering paste/add/remove with A active. Hygiene covers defensive destructuring, local boundary per entry, and host per-entry boundaries with the observability-vs-isolation trade-off.

caps.reason: Final remedy fixes plugin A's component; B is explicitly identified as never broken and reinstalling B is rejected.
